title: PLANK sessions
description: PLANK application metrics through Telegraf and an existing InfluxDB2 InfluxQL data source. No database URL, credentials or bucket binding is embedded.

list.name: hosts
list.label: Hosts
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "plank_transport" WITH KEY = "host" WHERE "role" = 'host'

list.name: clients
list.label: Clients
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "plank_transport" WITH KEY = "host" WHERE "role" = 'client'

panels.title: Wacom Tablet Activity
panels.description: Actual pen activity in each one-second reporting interval, with no active hold period. Green means movement or tip-down in that sample; gray means the pen source was observed with no activity. No data means it was not observed or a sample is missing. Includes focused active PLANK sessions on Ubuntu Clients only. Multiple sessions share a Client row. Telegraf buffering can delay the newest samples.

panels.title: QUIC round-trip time
panels.description: Measured transport RTT. Host and Client observations are separate; this is not glass-to-glass latency.

panels.title: Encoded video payload
panels.description: Measured Host video send and Client video receive rates. Payload excludes FEC and QUIC/IP overhead.

panels.title: Host Encoder Target
panels.description: Configured encoder bitrate target for the selected Hosts, in Mbps.

panels.title: Incoming video loss — before / after FEC
panels.description: Client RaptorQ source-symbol counters, weighted by source symbols in each chart interval. Repair symbols are excluded. Missing/no-source intervals stay empty. Unlike the toolbar, these are not ten-second peak percentages.

panels.title: Client frame rate — network / decode / render
panels.description: Actual decoder statistics windows. Missing observations remain gaps; do not interpret them as measured zero FPS.

panels.title: Client timing — decode / queue / render
panels.description: Mean timing within each actual decoder window. Render queue timing is not audio delay; these values do not measure end-to-end latency.

panels.title: Host processing
panels.description: Host processing metadata covers the capture/encoder path as instrumented by that platform. It is not a separate GPU encode measurement. Zero/unknown samples are excluded.

panels.title: QUIC and protocol drops
panels.description: Events per chart interval. QUIC loss includes transport traffic; it must not be divided by RaptorQ video-symbol counts or labeled video packet loss.

panels.title: Client frame drops
panels.description: Dropped frames per chart interval. Network frame gaps differ from residual FEC source-symbol loss. Render and overflow drops are local to the Client.

panels.title: Encoded audio payload
panels.description: Encoded Host audio send rate and Client audio receive rate. Microphone uplink is a separate stream and is not represented by these counters.
